scheme_name: Stipend For Girls Of Secondary Students Schemes
other_conditions: Must be studying in class 9th or 10th at the time of application
Must have passed the previous class with at least 50% marks
Must have an attendance record of at least 70% in the previous academic year
Must be enrolled in a government or government-recognized school in Nagaland
benefits_summary: Eligible girls receive a scholarship of Rs. 2000 per year to help cover education-related expenses.
